prerequisites.reason: Backpropagation is defined for training neural networks, so the network structure must be understood first.
Gradient descent minimizes an objective such as a loss function, so the loss being optimized must be understood first.
Backpropagation training uses gradients to update parameters through gradient-based optimization.
Backpropagation requires differentiating through activation functions to compute gradients.
Backpropagation starts from the training error measured by a loss function and propagates its gradients backward.
